findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search, fetch, web.search, news.brief · Private data: runs.launch, runs.wait, billing.topup_terms, modes.list · Public sink: web.search · Destructive: route.classify, runs.launch, runs.get, runs.wait, runs.report.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search, fetch, web.search, news.brief · Private data: runs.launch, runs.wait, billing.topup_terms, modes.list · Public sink: web.search · Destructive: route.classify, runs.launch, runs.get, runs.wait, runs.report

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
